CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  2175 Cherry Avenue • Signal Hill, California 90755-3799

  THE CITY OF SIGNAL HILL
  WELCOMES YOU TO A SPECIAL
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  November 09, 2022

Notice is hereby given that the City Council will hold a Special Meeting on Wednesday,
November 9, 2022, at 5:30 p.m. in the Lower Level Conference Room of City Hall, 2175
Cherry Avenue, Signal Hill, California.

City Council Members are compensated $694.14 per month. City Clerk and City Treasurer are
compensated $421.20 per month.

(1)  CALL TO ORDER – 5:30 P.M.

(2)  ROLL CALL

  MAYOR JONES
  VICE MAYOR HANSEN
  COUNCIL MEMBER COPELAND
  COUNCIL MEMBER WILSON
  COUNCIL MEMBER WOODS
(3)  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

(4)  PUBLIC BUSINESS FROM THE FLOOR ON CLOSED SESSION ITEM

(5)  CLOSED SESSION

  a.  A CLOSED SESSION WILL BE HELD PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE
  SECTION 54957 REGARDING PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT.

  TITLE: CITY MANAGER

(6)  RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

(7)  RECONVENE SPECIAL MEETING

(8)  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Page 1 of 2
 City Council  Special  November 9, 2022

(9)  ADJOURNMENT

  Tonight’s meeting will be adjourned to the special meeting of the Signal Hill City
  Council to be held on Wednesday, November 16, 2022 at 5:30 p.m. in the Lower Level
  Conference Room of City Hall, 2175 Cherry Avenue, Signal Hill, California. There will
  be no regular meeting of the Signal Hill City Council on Tuesday, November 22, 2022.
  The next regular meeting of the Signal Hill City Council will be held on Tuesday,
  December 13, 2022, at 7:00 p.m. (hybrid meeting format, including in-person, and
  video and teleconference participation options). Instructions to participate in the
  meeting will be provided on the meeting agenda.
CITIZEN PARTICIPATION

  Routine matters are handled most quickly and efficiently if contact is made with the City
  department directly concerned. However, if you would like to request that a matter be
  presented for City Council consideration, you may do so by writing to the City Council,
  City Clerk, or City Manager.

  If you need special assistance beyond what is normally provided to participate in City
  meetings, the City will attempt to accommodate you in every reasonable manner.
  Please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 989-7305 at least 48 hours prior to the
  meeting to inform us of your particular needs and to determine if accommodation is
  feasible.

  Page 2 of 2
